description: A writer and a reviewer, two Claude Code sessions on one machine, taking turns.

windows.title: writer
windows.run: COMPLIER_MACHINE=review-gate COMPLIER_ROLE=writer claude --plugin-dir ~/.complier/plugin 'You are the writer: follow WRITER.md.'

windows.title: reviewer
windows.run: COMPLIER_MACHINE=review-gate COMPLIER_ROLE=reviewer claude --plugin-dir ~/.complier/plugin 'You are the reviewer: follow REVIEWER.md.'

setup.title: Start the writer (in ~/two-agents/workspace)
setup.text: COMPLIER_MACHINE=review-gate COMPLIER_ROLE=writer claude --plugin-dir ~/.complier/plugin 'You are the writer: follow WRITER.md.'

setup.title: Start the reviewer (in ~/two-agents/workspace)
setup.text: COMPLIER_MACHINE=review-gate COMPLIER_ROLE=reviewer claude --plugin-dir ~/.complier/plugin 'You are the reviewer: follow REVIEWER.md.'
